t: Two things promised for one act
a: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَأَنْ يُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ
p: Man sarrahu an yubsaṭa lahu fī rizqihi wa an yunsaʾa lahu fī atharih, fa-l-yaṣil raḥimah
m: Whoever would like his provision widened and his trace extended, let him keep the ties of his kinship.
